text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Après la pluie,
le beau temps."
I promise to make the skies clear after this rain.
choice_data_list: Let's not rush—let's take it slow.
We need to review the issues once more.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Rushing won't do any good.
I just need to take it step by step and do what I can.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Even if I'm not in full bloom right now,
one day, without a doubt――"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: First, let's review today's race. Once we get back, I'll check the video footage of the run...
choice_data_list: Alright! There's no time like the present!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In order to plan our next steps, I hurried to get ready and leave the waiting room.
